title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final answer as (a).

title: Correct Equations
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly state the equations for the Bohr radius and the Compton wavelength.

title: Ratio Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the ratio of the Bohr radius to the Compton wavelength.

title: Fine-Structure Constant
description: Important Criteria: The student should recognize the significance of the fine-structure constant in the calculation.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student may check that the units of the Bohr radius and Compton wavelength are consistent.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as miscalculating the ratio or misinterpreting the constants involved.
